mentions.name: Turd Turf
mentions.description: A free-to-play brain training game heavy on toilet humor, with the goal of improving working memory, processing speed, and mental math.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently released what I think is an incredibly fun brain training app. It's heavy on toilet humor, but the goal is to improve your working memory, processing speed, and mental math. It's called Turd Turf and it's completely free to play- you can check it out here: https://turdturf.app
